subject: Re: BlueGrove SIG/CAIQ: transit key wrapping, KEK rotation, and HSM artifacts
messages:
From: Alice Martin <alice.martin@bluegrove.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: security@bluegrove.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ follow-up — envelope encryption & key rotation evidence

Evelyn,

Thanks again for the overview on Friday. As we prepare our SIG/CAIQ submission, the security team asked for a concise set of artifacts showing how Redwood handles customer-specific key material and how keys are protected in transit. Specifically, they asked for: 

- A short description of the envelope encryption model (KEK vs DEK), including where KEKs are stored and how DEKs are derived/wrapped at request time.
- HSM attestation or vendor report used during onboarding (FIPS/HSM vendor statement).
- A rotation schedule and proof that automated rotation runs without downtime (timestamps or logs are fine).
- Example of the TLS/transit wrapping sequence for inter-service requests (diagram or command sequence).

We don't need full source material — just evidence we can include in the CAIQ and hand to our audit team. Would you be able to deliver a compact package (PDFs/CSV + a short note) by Wednesday EOW Pacific?

Regards,
Alice Martin\Director, Information Security\BlueGrove Financial
From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: Alice Martin <alice.martin@bluegrove.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up — envelope encryption & key rotation evidence

Alice —

Thanks — we can definitely provide a compact evidence bundle. High level plan: 

1) Pack: HSM attestation PDF + anonymized keystore access matrix (xlsx) + KEK rotation schedule (CSV) + transit wrapping diagram (PNG).
2) Short cover note (1 page) that maps each artifact to CAIQ/SIG questions.
3) Redactions: we will redact internal hostnames and operator logins; we will provide example log timestamps for rotation runs.

I'll coordinate delivery. Ben, can your team produce the rotation timestamps and the wrap sequence diagram? Irene, can you pull the latest HSM attestation file we shipped during onboarding and a summary sentence about signed firmware/versioning?

Delivering by EOD Wednesday (Apr 13) PT. If that's tight for you please let me know.

Best,
Evelyn Hart\Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance\Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up — envelope encryption & key rotation evidence

Eve — quick status from infra/ops: 

- KEK/DEK model: KEKs are customer-specific, stored encrypted and wrapped in the HSM (AWS CloudHSM / Nitro enclave depending on deployment). DEKs are generated per-tenant on first object creation, wrapped with the tenant KEK and stored alongside the object metadata.
- Rotation windows: automated rotation runs weekly for ephemeral KEKs (30-day TTL on ephemeral KEKs), quarterly scheduled rotation for long-lived tenant KEKs, with an emergency revocation path. I'll attach the rotation CSV with sample run timestamps.
- Transit wrapping: our inter-service transit uses mTLS + an additional envelope wrap performed at the service boundary; attachment shows a sequence diagram and an example curl+openssl flow for reproducing a wrapped call.

Attachments I'll include: kek_rotation_windows_2027.csv, transit_wrapping_sequence.png, keystore_access_matrix_anon.xlsx

Jonas, can you confirm the HSM attestation file we have is the latest? Irene — I'll reference the attestation PDF from Nov 2026 unless you have a newer version.

-ben
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up — CAIQ evidence package for BlueGrove

Ben / Eve — attaching the HSM vendor attestation we keep for onboarding (redwood_hsm_attestation_2026-11.pdf). Notes: 

- The attestation includes FIPS level and vendor-signed material; we have a current firmware snapshot and the HSM serial prefix (redacted).
- Access matrix is anonymized: we removed operator usernames and replaced with roles (e.g., crypto-ops, infra-oncall).
- For rotation proof, I've exported sample rotation job logs showing start/end timestamps and KID before/after. We will include two sample timestamps to avoid exposing customer data.

I ran a quick smoke of the wrap flow and included a simple HTTP example in transit_wrapping_sequence.png. Let me know if BlueGrove wants raw logs — we should gate those through the legal redaction process.

-Irene
From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: Alice Martin <alice.martin@bluegrove.com>
Cc: security@bluegrove.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up — envelope encryption & key rotation evidence

Alice —

Attached is the evidence bundle for BlueGrove (see attachments). Summary: 

- redwood_hsm_attestation_2026-11.pdf — vendor attestation and FIPS statement (redacted serials).
- kek_rotation_windows_2027.csv — scheduled rotation cadence and two sample job timestamps showing no service interruption.
- transit_wrapping_sequence.png — diagram + short curl/openssl example describing the envelope wrapping at service boundary.
- keystore_access_matrix_anon.xlsx — role-based access matrix with anomalous access controls highlighted.

If the audit needs more granularity (e.g., raw logs or HSM console exports) we'll go through a brief redaction/legal transfer; happy to walk your auditors through the artifacts in a 30-minute call. 

Next steps: if you sign off, we'll provide a one-page mapping to SIG/CAIQ questions that references the artifact names and where to paste excerpts. We can deliver that tomorrow morning.

Best,
Evelyn Hart\Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance\Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_hsm_attestation_2026-11.pdf (application/pdf), kek_rotation_windows_2027.csv (text/csv), transit_wrapping_sequence.png (image/png), keystore_access_matrix_anon.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
